description: Maybach Ultimate Luxury is an iconic Mercedes-branded residential development by Binghatti, located in the prestigious Meydan district. The project features two striking towers, each comprising a basement level, ground floor, mezzanine, five podium levels, and an elegant residential structure - with nineteen floors in Tower A and twenty-five in Tower B. Designed to embody sophistication and architectural excellence, the complex stands as a symbol of branded luxury living in Dubai. The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit both homeowners and investors. Interiors showcase a contemporary aesthetic defined by clean architectural lines, premium materials, rich textures, and a warm, elegant color palette. Every detail is curated to reflect understated luxury and timeless style. Residents are treated to an exceptional array of lifestyle amenities, including a stunning infinity swimming pool, a shared jacuzzi, and dedicated outdoor yoga spaces. The development also features beautifully designed leisure and relaxation areas, premium beauty salons, diverse dining outlets, and well-equipped sports facilities. Location description and benefits Meydan is one of Dubai's most ambitious and prestigious districts, designed as a contemporary urban destination where luxury, nature, and innovation converge. Known for its expansive open spaces and iconic skyline views, the area blends modern residential developments with landscaped parks, waterways, and cultural landmarks. Meydan's master-planned environment offers a sense of scale, openness, and refinement rarely found in central urban locations. The district is internationally recognized for Meydan Racecourse, a world-class equestrian and sporting venue that hosts prestigious global events and anchors the area's elite identity. Surrounding the racecourse are premium residential communities, leisure destinations, retail concepts, and wellness-focused spaces, all thoughtfully integrated to support a high-quality lifestyle. Wide boulevards, pedestrian-friendly planning, and scenic vistas define the everyday experience in Meydan. Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. Its limited land availability, ongoing development momentum, and growing demand for branded and luxury residences position Meydan as a prime destination for end-users and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai's most forward-looking districts.

description: Binghatti Spectre is a mixed-use development by Binghatti, presented under the concept "A Presence Beyond the Visible." The project comprises two towers of contrasting heights rising above a shared podium base, with a sculptural, fluid silhouette. Residence formats include studios, apartments, and Royal Suites in one-, two-, and three-bedroom configurations, alongside dedicated office and retail space. The development is positioned as a contemporary residential and commercial destination, complemented by panoramic city views. Residents have access to a dedicated pool for adults and children, together with a yoga and aerobics platform and a paddle and tennis court for active pursuits. A children's play area sits alongside family sitting and social nooks, while wellness facilities and lounge sitting platforms provide space for relaxation. The development also includes an open lawn, a dedicated jogging and sprint lane, and activity tables with a ping-pong table for recreation. Interior layouts range from efficient studios to expansive three-bedroom residences, with the largest configurations featuring a private pool and a terrace open to the sky, plus dedicated laundry space. Rooms are organized around distinct living, dining, and kitchen zones, with master suites in the larger units. The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout, and are delivered unfurnished. Location description and benefits Al Jaddaf is a vibrant and rapidly developing neighborhood located on the banks of Dubai Creek. Known for its strategic location, Al Jaddaf is situated between Dubai's old town and the bustling modern hubs of Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. This unique positioning makes it a desirable area for both residents and businesses, offering seamless connectivity to key parts of the city via major highways like Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, as well as easy access to public transport, including the Dubai Metro and Creek ferry services. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport further enhances its appeal as a convenient and well-connected neighborhood. The area is a blend of tradition and modernity, reflecting Dubai's rich cultural heritage while embracing contemporary urban development. Al Jaddaf is home to the iconic Dubai Frame, a major landmark that offers breathtaking views of the city, and the historical Dubai Creek, which retains its charm as a hub of the city's maritime and trade history. The area also features the Jameel Arts Centre, a cultural hotspot showcasing contemporary art and fostering creative expression, making Al Jaddaf an attractive destination for art and culture enthusiasts. Al Jaddaf offers a well-rounded lifestyle with a growing array of residential, commercial, and leisure options. It features a variety of modern apartment complexes, many of which boast waterfront views and state-of-the-art amenities. The neighborhood's emphasis on green spaces, including the landscaped walkways along the creek, promotes outdoor activities and a healthy lifestyle. With upcoming developments and a focus on enhancing community living, Al Jaddaf continues to grow as one of Dubai's most promising and sought-after residential and cultural hubs.

description: Exclusive Waterfront Apartments with Wynn Casino Views in Ras Al Khaimah Ras Al Khaimah, the northernmost emirate of the UAE, is renowned for its stunning coastline, majestic mountains, and rapidly growing luxury real estate market. This dynamic destination blends rich cultural heritage with modern infrastructure, offering residents and investors a high-quality lifestyle. One of the most anticipated developments in the region is the Wynn Al Marjan Island, the UAE's first integrated gaming and resort destination. Set to open in 2027, this mega-project will feature a world-class casino, luxury hotels, fine dining, and entertainment experiences, making Ras Al Khaimah a premier global tourism and investment hub. With its breathtaking waterfront views, expanding infrastructure, and promising economic growth, Ras Al Khaimah is quickly becoming one of the most sought-after locations in the UAE for luxury living and investment opportunities. are conveniently located just 3 minutes from Al Hamra Mall, 6 minutes from Al Marjan Island Beach and Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club, 13 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah Corniche, 15 minutes from Wynn Casino, 25 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah International Airport, 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport, and 55 minutes from Downtown Dubai. Designed as an exclusive waterfront community, this development seamlessly blends modern luxury with natural tranquility. It features five elegant 18-story towers, each offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Wynn Al Marjan Island. Inspired by traditional Arabic architecture, the exteriors combine earthy tones and contemporary design, creating a visually striking yet serene environment. Residents can enjoy direct sea access and an extensive array of world-class amenities, including a scenic promenade, state-of-the-art fitness center, coworking spaces, an entertainment room, multiple swimming pools, a kids' play area, jogging tracks, and championship padel tennis courts. For outdoor enthusiasts, lush parks, a dedicated pet-friendly zone with grooming services, and barbecue areas enhance the community's appeal. The development is further enriched by its proximity to the Royal Yacht Club, Al Hamra Golf Club, and an array of luxury hotels, fine dining, and high-end retail outlets, ensuring a sophisticated yet relaxed lifestyle. The project offers a meticulously designed collection of residences, including spacious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each crafted for modern comfort and elegance. Interiors are thoughtfully planned with open layouts that maximize natural light, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning sea views. High-quality finishes and premium materials create a sophisticated ambiance, complemented by neutral, earthy tones inspired by the surrounding landscape. Each residence is equipped with fitted wardrobes, ensuring ample storage space, and a fully integrated kitchen with high-end white goods, blending convenience with contemporary aesthetics. description:
Ocean Star is a residential development by Emaar Properties, located within Rashid Yachts & Marina at Mina Rashid, Dubai. The project comprises two residential buildings offering a selection of one, two and three-bedroom apartments, combining contemporary interiors with a waterfront setting and access to the wider marina community.
The development includes 154 residential apartments, comprising 58 one-bedroom, 76 two-bedroom and 20 three-bedroom homes. The apartments feature practical layouts, spacious living areas and private balconies or terraces, with a range of configurations to suit different household needs. The supplied floor plans cover 38 layout variations, with total apartment areas ranging from approximately 789.9 to 2,025 sq ft.
One-bedroom apartments offer efficient layouts with private outdoor space, while two-bedroom residences provide additional room for families and shared living. Three-bedroom apartments feature larger interiors and, in selected layouts, substantially larger balconies or terraces. The combination of indoor living space and private outdoor areas contributes to the development's residential appeal.
Ocean Star is designed around a waterfront lifestyle, with a signature canal pool, landscaped green spaces and recreational facilities. Residents can enjoy access to a gym, recreational courts, a community park and a boardwalk promenade. The surrounding community also provides access to marina facilities, retail and dining options, and nearby educational and healthcare facilities.
Located within Rashid Yachts & Marina, Ocean Star offers access to the waterfront promenade and the wider marina environment. Dubai International Airport is approximately 15 minutes away by car, while Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are around 20 minutes away. With its range of apartment sizes, waterfront setting and community facilities, Ocean Star offers an appealing option for end-users, families and investors seeking a home in Dubai's marina district.

Its master-planned concept emphasizes convenience, with opportunities for shopping, dining, recreation, and everyday activities within the wider district. City of Arabia is associated with major leisure and retail concepts, including the planned Mall of Arabia and the Restless Planet attraction. These proposed destinations form part of the area's long-term vision to establish a vibrant entertainment and lifestyle hub. As development progresses, the district aims to offer residents a broader selection of retail, dining, and family-oriented experiences, adding to its potential appeal as a residential destination. The wider Dubailand area benefits from road connections to other parts of Dubai, while ongoing development continues to shape its residential and commercial landscape. Planned infrastructure and leisure destinations contribute to the area's long-term vision, although individual projects and transport links may progress in phases. For buyers and investors, Laguna Residence offers a distinctive proposition through its signature lagoon concept, contemporary residences, and extensive amenities within an emerging urban community.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. description: Studio Apartment with Terrace and Sea View in Palm Jumeirah Palm Jumeirah is one of Dubai's most iconic waterfront destinations, an artificial island shaped like a palm tree and known for its luxury lifestyle. It offers a unique and compelling blend of beachfront living, world-class dining, and high-end leisure attractions, making it one of the most coveted addresses in the region. With breathtaking sea views, a vibrant social scene, and seamless access to the wider city, it consistently remains a top choice for both discerning residents and savvy investors alike. This sits in a waterfront development designed with immaculate, contemporary lines and a philosophy that leverages its stunning waterfront location and private beach access. Connectivity is a defining advantage of its location: Atlantis the Palm Hotel is just 5 minutes away, Nakheel Mall is reachable in 10 minutes, Madinat Jumeirah in 20 minutes, and Dubai International Airport in approximately 40 minutes, placing the very best of Dubai well within reach. description: Etherea is a contemporary residential development designed around the principles of balance, privacy, and understated elegance. Offering a tranquil retreat from the pace of city life, the project combines architectural precision, harmonious proportions, and thoughtfully designed spaces to create a distinctive residential experience. Defined by clean lines, natural textures, and a considered approach to modern design, Etherea creates an atmosphere where light, space, and materials work together seamlessly. Its architectural character reflects a philosophy of quiet sophistication, offering residents a peaceful environment within Dubai's evolving urban landscape. Lifestyle Amenities & Wellness Etherea features a thoughtfully curated collection of lifestyle amenities designed to promote relaxation, recreation, and everyday wellbeing. The dedicated amenity deck offers a welcoming environment for residents to unwind, stay active, and connect with their surroundings. Key amenities include: Adult and children's swimming pools Jacuzzi and outdoor shower facilities Sun lounging areas Landscaped walking and cycling paths Dedicated yoga and aerobics platform Shaded seating and relaxation areas Children's play areas With its landscaped surroundings, greenery, and carefully arranged outdoor spaces, the development encourages a balanced lifestyle centred on comfort, wellness, and community living. Premium Interiors & Timeless Finishes The residences at Etherea showcase a sophisticated palette of natural materials and carefully selected finishes, creating interiors that feel warm, elegant, and contemporary. Stone travertine flooring is complemented by marble feature surfaces and fluted oak wood elements in natural and painted finishes. White painted walls, wood panelling, and selected feature wallcoverings add depth and texture, while bronze-toned metal accents and tinted bronze mirrors introduce subtle refinement. Kitchens are seamlessly integrated into the living spaces, featuring bespoke cabinetry and elegant stone finishes that combine visual appeal with everyday functionality. Carefully selected built-in furniture elements further enhance the interiors, reflecting the development's emphasis on material quality, thoughtful detailing, and understated luxury. Prime Location - Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) Located in Jumeirah Village Circle, Etherea benefits from a well-established residential community known for its landscaped parks, tree-lined streets, and diverse selection of apartments, townhouses, and villas. JVC offers a balance of peaceful residential surroundings and everyday urban convenience. Residents have access to supermarkets, retail outlets, cafés, restaurants, schools, fitness facilities, and recreational spaces within the wider community. The neighbourhood's green spaces and family-friendly environment make it appealing to families, professionals, and individuals seeking a comfortable home away from the intensity of Dubai's busiest districts, while remaining connected to the city's major destinations. A New Perspective on Contemporary Living Etherea brings together refined architecture, premium natural finishes, wellness-focused amenities, and the established residential appeal of Jumeirah Village Circle. Designed for those who value privacy, tranquillity, and thoughtful contemporary design, the development offers a distinctive approach to modern living in Dubai. Discover a lifestyle where architectural elegance meets everyday serenity.

description: Most waterfront listings promise a view. This one hands you the beach itself. This one bedroom residence at Costa Mare sits inside a four-tower freehold community on Al Marjan Island, where the development's private beach is closer than the walk to your own building's parking. Al Marjan Island is one of the fastest-growing waterfront addresses in the UAE, under two hours from both Dubai and Abu Dhabi, and already home to the Wynn Resort and a growing run of beach clubs. description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

description: Modern Waterfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a natural sanctuary renowned for its unspoiled white sand beaches, clear blue waters, and rich biodiversity, including mangroves that provide habitat for species such as flamingos, turtles, oryxes, and gazelles. The island holds historical significance as the oldest pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf and is home to an ancient Eastern Christian monastery, reflecting its vibrant past. Recent developments aim to transform Siniyah Island into a premier destination, blending luxury living with ecological preservation while maintaining its cultural heritage. Apartments for sale on Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, are conveniently located just 5 minutes from essential services, 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project is situated in a stunning island setting, blending refined waterfront elegance and lush natural beauty. Its exterior showcases contemporary architectural brilliance seamlessly integrated with serene sea views, sun-drenched promenades, and a dynamic marina. The residences boast direct access to a motorized seawater body, a yacht club with mooring facilities, and a lively promenade enriched by fine dining, boutique cafés, and vibrant nightlife. Residents enjoy podium-level infinity pools, cutting-edge fitness centers with marina views, cozy lounges, and engaging outdoor play zones. Expansive landscaped gardens and parks add to the tranquil setting, while a luxury hotel and a high-end mall offer indulgence and convenience. Additional features include a fully operational golf course, helipad, exclusive resorts, and seamless pedestrian connectivity via a scenic bridge, all thoughtfully designed to elevate coastal living into a lifestyle of refined leisure and adventure. The project presents a refined selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, where modern design meets exceptional functionality across three residential towers. Tower C offers fully furnished units, offering a sophisticated turnkey solution with elegant furniture, fitted wardrobes, and kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods for a seamless move-in experience. Towers A and B are semi-furnished, featuring the same premium built-in wardrobes and fully fitted kitchens, allowing residents to personalize their living spaces while enjoying core conveniences. Interiors are spacious and light-filled, enhanced by thoughtfully curated layouts, en-suite bathrooms, powder rooms, and private balconies that frame serene views of the marina, park, or sea. Every detail has been crafted to reflect contemporary coastal elegance, offering residents a perfect balance between luxurious comfort and everyday practicality. UAQ-00010

description: Beachfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island in Umm Al-Quwain is a stunning haven that blends luxurious living with breathtaking natural surroundings. This exclusive community offers a range of upscale residences, including waterfront villas and elegant apartments, thoughtfully crafted for a sophisticated island lifestyle. Residents benefit from direct beach access, expansive green spaces, and world-class amenities such as an 18-hole golf course, eco-park, and water sports adventures. With its rich ecological diversity and cultural heritage, Siniyah Island provides a peaceful escape just 50 minutes from Dubai, perfectly balancing tranquility and urban convenience. Umm Al Quwain are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious lifestyle harmoniously integrated with natural beauty, featuring state-of-the-art residential units within multi-use towers ranging from 2 to 10 stories. The development is surrounded by pristine white sand beaches, lush mangroves, and a rich tapestry of unique wildlife. Community amenities include a recreational fishing deck, family-oriented golf course, event cabanas, al fresco dining, and luxury beach cabanas. A seawater lagoon is central to the community, providing facilities for non-motorized water sports such as snorkeling, paddleboarding, kayaking, and floating cinema experiences. Linear parks are equipped with yoga decks, wellness parks, and sports facilities like tennis and paddle courts, alongside skateboarding zones. Additional highlights include a yacht club, mosque, retail mall, public beach, and helicopter landing pad. Residents can enjoy a clubhouse with a gym, library lounge, steam and sauna rooms, and multipurpose spaces. The development also prioritizes sustainability with double-glazed façades, energy-efficient systems, and provisions for electric vehicle charging. The project features meticulously designed interiors that combine elegance with functionality, offering 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts and high-quality finishes. Each unit is equipped with fitted wardrobes and kitchens that include premium white goods such as an oven, gas hob and hood, refrigerator, and washing machine. The living and bedroom areas are adorned with porcelain tile flooring and finished with matte emulsion paint walls for a sleek yet cozy ambiance. The master bedrooms boast en-suite bathrooms, while all bathrooms and powder rooms are outfitted with premium-brand water closets, washbasins, and chrome-plated fittings. Kitchens feature high-quality reconstituted stone countertops and laminate or high-gloss PET-finished cabinets. The design emphasizes luxury and practicality, with concealed cisterns in bathrooms and carefully selected finishes throughout to enhance the overall living experience. UAQ-00004

The two towers are linked by a four-story atrium at ground level with a bridge connecting 71 meters above the ground. The bridge is constructed with double-curved glass, double-curved aluminum frames, and steel elements. The bridge consists of three storeys offering spectacular views and the feeling of being at the top. The 96 units in Opus are available in a range of sizes, from one and two-bedroom apartments to exceptional duplexes and triplexes. description: Discover a lifestyle where the beauty of nature meets the energy of the city. Surrounded by tranquil creek views, striking skylines, and lush green landscapes, this exceptional residential destination offers a harmonious blend of serenity, contemporary design, and urban sophistication. The wider destination is also associated with the ambitious Dubai Creek Tower project, designed by renowned architect Santiago Calatrava as a landmark of architectural innovation. Together with the area's contemporary skyline, waterfront promenades, and carefully planned public spaces, these features contribute to its distinctive identity. Dubai Creek Harbour offers a lifestyle that combines scenic surroundings with convenient access to retail, dining, and leisure experiences. Its emphasis on open spaces, waterfront living, and modern urban design makes it an appealing choice for residents seeking a balance between city convenience and natural tranquillity. With its striking views, evolving skyline, and vibrant waterfront atmosphere, Dubai Creek Harbour represents a compelling vision of contemporary living in one of Dubai's most distinctive residential destinations.

Comprising four coral-shaped islands, Breeze, Treasure, Dream, and View, it is home to luxury resorts, beach clubs, water sports, and world-class hospitality brands like Rixos, Mövenpick, and DoubleTree. With upcoming landmark developments such as Nobu and the Wynn Resort, Al Marjan Island is rapidly emerging as a premier destination for waterfront living, tourism, and high-return real estate investment, just 45 minutes from Dubai. The project rises 16 storeys above the Arabian Gulf on Al Marjan Island, designed as a sculptural icon that cascades organically towards the sea, blending architecture with nature to create an exclusive waterfront sanctuary. Its bold yet fluid form is complemented by lush tropical landscaping and flowing water features that embrace a serene promenade. At its core, this development offers a curated lifestyle of wellness and luxury, with world-class amenities such as a state-of-the-art gym, yoga studio, infinity pool, children's pool, padel court, jogging track, family lawn, and scenic garden spaces. Residents are welcomed through a grand arrival drop-off and a striking residential lobby, with direct access to retail outlets at the ground level. Thoughtfully designed terraces and curved balconies frame uninterrupted panoramic sea views and golden sunsets, while tranquil zones like the activity lawn, sunken seating areas, and waterscapes foster relaxation and community. The architectural layout integrates seamlessly with its environment. This destination is just minutes from the upcoming Wynn Resort and key Ras Al Khaimah attractions, positioning it as a prime address for upscale living and future investment. The project presents a refined collection of studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, meticulously designed to blend contemporary luxury with serene coastal living. Each apartment features thoughtfully planned layouts with generous living spaces, high ceilings, and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the interiors with natural light while offering sweeping views of the sea. title: Union Takaya
description:
Takaya is being developed by Union Properties beside Dubai Autodrome in Motor City, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It combines three towers: Takaya Tower rises 29 floors above ground, basement and podium levels, while Symphony and Harmony each have 19. Townhouses and villas sit around a shared podium, for a total of 744 apartments, 39 townhouses and five villas plus retail units. Apartments run from studios to four bedrooms, with one- to four-bedroom layouts of 831 sq ft to 2,339 sq ft, and the four-bedroom townhouses are set over three levels with a roof terrace.

Homes are handed over semi-furnished, with soft pastel interiors and kitchens fitted with Siemens appliances; many layouts add a maid's room and walk-in wardrobes. The 24 shared amenities include lap, recreational and children's pools, three gyms, two squash courts, a paddle tennis court, a golf simulator, a cinema room, co-working spaces, a children's day care and a sky garden. Parking is provided for 1,203 cars, 100 of them enabled for EV charging. A landscaped retail plaza sits at street level, and Motor City's gardens, cycle paths and the Dubai Outdoor Kartdrome are nearby.

Union Properties, founded in 1987 and publicly listed, is the developer behind Motor City, Dubai Autodrome and Uptown Mirdif, and has delivered more than 10,000 units in Dubai. Takaya adds a broad spread of apartment sizes and a limited number of townhouses and villas to this established community between major highways. The payment plan asks for 5% on booking and 15% during construction, with the remaining 80% due on handover, expected in Q4 2027.

The design palette embodies understated elegance, featuring soft neutral tones, premium finishes, and the incorporation of natural materials like stone to create a calm, organic ambiance. Residences come with fully fitted kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods, as well as built-in wardrobes that maximize storage while maintaining sleek, modern aesthetics. Spacious balconies extend the living areas outdoors, enhancing the connection to nature and creating private sanctuaries for relaxation. The interiors are a harmonious balance of functionality and style, crafted to deliver comfort, sophistication, and a lifestyle rooted in both beauty and practicality. RKT-00021
